title: Roamhaven Rewards Benefit Card — Courtesy on the Pet Deep-Clean Share
content:
# Roamhaven Rewards benefit card — courtesy on the pet deep-clean share

**Benefit.** On a cancelled reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, Roamhaven Rewards members get a courtesy on the deep-clean share kept from the pet fee: a guest whose active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes a dedicated concierge has 100 percent of the deep-clean share waived; a guest whose active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes the priority support line but no dedicated concierge has 50 percent of it waived; any other guest has none of it waived. The part waived is returned with the pet-fee refund instead of being kept, before the refund is rounded to the cent.

The guest's Roamhaven Rewards membership on record decides: its tier, the features of that tier, and whether it is active.

| Roamhaven Rewards membership | Part of the deep-clean share waived |
|---|---|
| active; tier includes a dedicated concierge | 100 percent |
| active; tier includes the priority support line, no dedicated concierge | 50 percent |
| any other case, including no active membership | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical deep-clean share of 35 percent)

| Membership | Waived | Share of the refundable pet fee still kept |
|---|---|---|
| dedicated concierge | 100 percent | 0 percent |
| priority support line only | 50 percent | 17.5 percent |
| neither | none | 35 percent |
